_comment: icraft relocation (2026-05-30): Sorceress Circe's Mausoleum moved from overworld taiga to the End (T4). She is a dark/evil sorceress (malediction_bracelets, evil_king_armor drops) -- a desolate End island tomb fits her theme and matches her endgame summon gate, per the location-based tiering pass (#54). Target end_highlands/end_midlands (the solid outer islands where End Cities generate) so it lands on ground, not the void. NOTE: new-chunks-only -- already-generated End chunks won't retroactively contain it.
